reasonCodeDescription: Exceeds Floor Limit — Not Authorized and Fraud

statement.disputeReason: 4847 - Exceeds Floor Limit — Not Authorized and Fraud
statement.detailedDescription: A $1,250.00 purchase of a high-end television from 'ELECTROWORLD MEGASTORE' was processed without authorization from the issuer. The transaction amount exceeds the applicable floor limit and the merchant was required to obtain real-time authorization. The cardholder's card was stolen [1 day before this transaction] and they did not make this purchase.
statement.merchantResponseSummary: N/A — card was stolen; cardholder did not visit this store.
statement.requestedResolution: Full reversal. Transaction exceeds floor limit, no authorization obtained, and the transaction is fraudulent.
statement.cardholderDeclaration: I declare that the information provided in this dispute statement is true, accurate, and complete to the best of my knowledge and belief.

bankInternalNotes.recommendedAction: Proceed with chargeback filing under Mastercard reason code 4847 (Exceeds Floor Limit — Not Authorized and Fraud).
